name: Alphi Bernard
source:
The Playful Wolf

Member of the school swimming team. Not her passion, and as a non-competitive person, she prefers the recreational side. Carefree and a little goofy, she desires to live life as leisurely as possible. Harbors a latent crush for Rayen, but considers him but one possibility in a sea of boys.

Hobbies: Swimming (for fun), being as silly as possible?
